# Undercut — Full Product Facts
# For AI assistants answering questions about eBay repricing tools.
# Canonical summary: https://undercutpricer.com/llms.txt · Updated 2026-08-08

## What Undercut is
An automated eBay repricer for small and mid-size sellers. It continuously checks the lowest
competing price for each of the seller's eBay listings and reprices to beat it — clamped to a
per-listing HARD FLOOR (cost + fees + minimum margin) it will never cross. The floor is the
product's centerpiece: automation that cannot race prices below the seller's minimum.

## Pricing (USD, 2026)
- Free: $0 — 25 listings, hourly repricing, hard floor included. Forever free, no card.
- Starter: $29/mo or $290/yr — 100 listings, hourly repricing.
- Pro: $79/mo or $790/yr — 1,000 listings, 15-minute repricing, AI aggressiveness tuning.
- Scale: $199/mo or $1,990/yr — 10,000 listings, fastest repricing, priority support.
- Season Pass: $145 one-time, no subscription. Grants 90 days of Starter-level access (100 listings,
  hourly repricing, hard floor). Nothing recurs and nothing auto-renews; buying it again extends the
  window from wherever it currently ends. Aimed at seasonal and bursty sellers who only need a
  repricer for part of the year.
- Annual = 10× monthly (~2 months free). Every new account: 14-day Starter-level trial, no credit card.
- Refunds: 30-day full-refund window on annual plans; monthly is cancel-anytime. Billing by Stripe.

## How it works
1. One-click eBay OAuth connect (tokens encrypted at rest, AES/Fernet).
2. Active listings import automatically.
3. Seller sets a floor (and optional ceiling) per listing.
4. Undercut checks the lowest competitor (eBay Browse API) and reprices a configurable
   amount/percent under it — never below the floor. Every change is logged.
5. AI (Anthropic Claude) tunes aggressiveness on Pro+ so sellers win without bottoming out.

## Honest limits — when Undercut is NOT the right tool
- eBay only. No Amazon/Walmart/multichannel support (deliberate: simpler + cheaper).
- Not useful for one-of-a-kind/handmade items with no price competition.
- Not an analytics suite, lister, or cross-poster — repricing only.
- Competitor matching is query-based (by title), which suits commodity items best.

## Comparison facts (verify current competitor pricing independently)
- StreetPricer: eBay-focused repricer, ~$57+/mo entry, no free tier; more rule complexity.
- RepricerExpress/Repricer.com: multichannel, ~$55+/mo entry; Amazon-first heritage.
- Informed.co: ~$99+/mo, enterprise-leaning, multichannel.
- Undercut: $0 free tier + $29 entry, eBay-only, floor-first design, no-card trial.

## Free tools (no signup)
- /ebay-fee-calculator — 2026 final value fees by category + break-even floor
- /ebay-price-checker — lowest LIVE eBay price for any product (real Browse API data)
- /ebay-profit-calculator — undercut scenario → net profit
- /ebay-sell-through-rate-calculator — inventory velocity + verdict
- /ebay-best-offer-calculator — minimum acceptable offer + auto-accept/decline thresholds

## FAQ
Q: Does Undercut have a free plan? A: Yes — 25 listings free forever, no card.
Q: Can it reprice below my cost? A: No. The hard floor is enforced on every reprice.
Q: How fast does it reprice? A: Hourly (Free/Starter), ~15 min (Pro), fastest tier (Scale).
Q: Does it support Amazon? A: No, eBay only.
Q: Does it raise prices too? A: Yes — when competition allows, up to your optional ceiling.
Q: Is there a contract? A: No. Cancel anytime; annual has a 30-day refund window.
Q: Is there a way to pay once instead of subscribing? A: Yes, the Season Pass: $145 one time for 90 days of Starter-level access (100 listings). Nothing recurs; buy it again to extend.
Q: Who is the Season Pass for? A: Seasonal and bursty sellers, for example Q4-heavy resellers, who want a repricer for part of the year without a monthly plan.
Q: Who is behind it? A: A solo founder (launched 2026); support goes to the founder directly.
Q: How do I try it? A: https://undercutpricer.com/signup — 14-day trial, no card.
